website-visitor-outreach.title: Turn de-anonymized website visitors into warm pipeline
website-visitor-outreach.label: Website visitor outreach
website-visitor-outreach.summary: See which companies visit your website and reach the good fits the same day.
website-visitor-outreach.prompt: Show me which companies and people visit our website, put them in our CRM with the page they looked at, tell me which ones fit who we sell to, and help me reach the good ones once I approve.
trigger_phrases: People visit our website but never convert
Who is on my site right now — and can we contact them?
Which companies visited our website this week?
website-visitor-outreach.business_case: Most people who visit your website leave without a trace. RB2B names some of them; OXYGEN puts each named visitor in your CRM with the page they saw and scores their company against who you sell to, so the good fits can get a personal note the same day.
website-visitor-outreach.outcome: Every visitor RB2B identifies lands in your CRM as a company and a person, with the visit on their timeline and their company scored for fit, plus a daily ranked list of who to contact first. Sending stays your call, through a small capped pilot.
website-visitor-outreach.leading_metric: good-fit visitors contacted within a day, and their replies
website-visitor-outreach.benchmark: RB2B identifies a minority of visits, mostly US business visitors (rough estimate: 20-40% on US-heavy sites), and only some of those fit who you sell to. A handful of good-fit visitors a week is normal early on; with little traffic it finds almost no one.

effort.time_to_value: after OXYGEN support connects RB2B; visitors then arrive as they come
effort.cadence: one-time setup, then a daily look at new visitors

credits.pilot: 0 to set up; then ~10 credits per new visitor for automatic CRM enrichment
credits.full: ~10 credits per new visitor; +10 per number found if the US phone lookup is on; RB2B bills itself

prerequisites.detail: Company profile filled in, including who you sell to: each visitor's company is scored against it.
RB2B (a separate paid product) on your website, connected to this workspace by OXYGEN support. There is no self-serve connect step yet.
CRM lists for companies and people. Creating them also switches on automatic paid enrichment of every new company and person.
